data.narrative:
Mammoth Biosciences is a Series D-stage biotech company founded by Jennifer Doudna and co-founders, having raised $600M+ to date. The valuation analysis employs two applicable triangulation methods against a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector at same or adjacent stages (Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, Chai Discovery, New Limit), supplemented by 3 public sector comps (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D-to-next advancement, yielding $900M based on the $600M raised proxy. The Peer-Median method anchors to the median valuation of $4.5B across the 4 identified private comparables, with a stated range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 6.6x) was not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target. 

Triangulation across the two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $765M (low) to $5.2B (high), with a median of $2.7B. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage-specific valuation progression and peer selection sensitivity, particularly given the heterogeneity within the private biotech comp set. Key uncertainties include validation of revenue trajectory and competitive positioning relative to the highest-valued peers in the sample.
